verdict.rationale: Goodwin's digital offering, Founders Workbench, is a set of free web tools (Document Driver, Capital and Liquidation Calculators), so a developer API is a plausible thing to ask about and the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows an API reference, runnable examples, or any programmatic interface. Probes found no OpenAPI or Swagger spec at any standard path and no llms.txt (all returned HTTP 404).
